category.description: Sound effects and ambience: a Universal Category System top-level category ("CROWDS") or CatID ("CRWDCheer").

chord.description: Chord a chord one-shot plays, e.g. "Am", "C#m7".

fit_seconds.description: The length to fill, e.g. 20 for a 20-second ad. Ranks sounds that can fill it and adds a fit hint ("trim", "loop ×2"); never filters.

good_for.description: Jobs the sound should suit. Ranks matches higher; never hides a sound.

loop_seamless.description: true: only sounds measured to loop seamlessly, e.g. game music that repeats under a scene.

mood.description: Any of these words; sounds matching more rank higher.

note.description: Note a pitched one-shot plays: "D3" (C3 = middle C), or "D" for any octave.

pack.description: A pack's id or slug, from a sound's pack or search_packs: only that pack's sounds.

parts.description: Music only: a finished mix, or one part of one.

q.description: Words, or a short brief: "door slam", or "corporate background music for a 20-second ad, no vocals". A brief is read into filters; the result's interpreted_as shows how, and you can send any of it back as a filter.

style.description: Sound effects only; set per pack, so most have none. Dropped (see relaxed_filters) when nothing matches with it.

type.description: What the sound is. Set it first.

name: search_sounds
title: Search sounds
